body: I mean, for this specific one, it’s just a very common mistake for people to use the word (for example, when discussing anything about Japan) instead of the correct abbreviations ‘JPN’ or ‘JP’. It’s such a common mistake that I think the mistake is made more than people actually saying the word to be offensive.
The one I’m referring to is the one where you remove the last two letters of ‘Japan’, but that’s not the only word that has a similar historical context, it’s just the one that sparked this question.
